name: @oleksandr_krupko/mac-os-debloat
description: Debloat your Mac from the terminal. SIP-safe interactive console util to disable 296 non-essential macOS launchd services + Spotlight toggle, with one-key telemetry/balanced presets in the TUI and your own custom presets. Self-validates against your macOS build; sections can be gated per macOS major. macOS Tahoe 26 and Golden Gate 27, Apple Silicon. Zero deps.
author: Oleksandr Krupko
